killedBy: hud: the match-failure overlay is reachable by keyboard and D-pad (issue #327) a controller's D-pad and Confirm both act inside the overlay
why: Drops the CONFIRM overlay out of `activePanelContainer`, which is the same defect the match-failure overlay shipped with until issue #327's audit found it: the arrow keys and a D-pad move nothing inside the pane, and Confirm lands nowhere, so its controls are reachable by pointer and Escape only. Two panes have now been left out of this list the same way -- the gallery workbench (#730, caught by #741) and this alert -- so the entry mutates the NEIGHBOUR rather than the line it protects, which is what makes it fail if either pane's coverage is the one that regresses. Measured before the fix: with the alert up, `act('down')` and `act('confirm')` both returned false while `confirmView` walked its two buttons normally.
